title: Install. Connect. Ask your agent.
subtitle: A shopping task, from first install to a useful answer.
narration: Let's install Account Access, connect a shopping account, and ask our AI agent to find the best priced products. You'll see the setup once, then use the account through your normal agent conversation.

title: Open Terminal on your Mac
subtitle: Have Git, uv, and your preferred AI agent installed.
cards: Use the agent you already have
narration: Start with Git, the u v package manager, and Codex or Claude Code installed and signed in. The guide below includes the installation links and every command you can copy.
note: macOS shown. Linux setup is covered in the written guide.

title: Download Account Access
subtitle: Run these commands in Terminal.
narration: Download the repository, then open its folder with the change directory command. Run the next installation commands from this folder.
tip: Copy the commands from the written guide.

title: Prepare Python and the browser
subtitle: Wait for each command to finish.
command:
uv sync --locked --python 3.13
uv run playwright install chromium
uv build
narration: Prepare Python and the required packages. Install Chromium for website access. Then build the package. Your first installation may take a few minutes.
tip: Keep this project folder open until installation is complete.
note: The written guide includes the additional browser setup for Linux.

title: Install the Account Access command
subtitle: The backslash continues this command onto the next line.
narration: Install Account Access as a command. If the terminal cannot find it afterward, run u v tool update shell, then open a new terminal.
tip:
Command not found?
uv tool update-shell
Open a new terminal.
note: Next: choose the service you want your agent to use.

title: Choose the service and install the skill
subtitle: This shopping connector is included in the repository.
command:
account-access init --config examples/shopping.json
account-access install --agent codex
account-access install --agent claude
output:
Configured account: shopping
Account Access skill installed
narration: Initialize the account using its service connector. This walkthrough uses the included shopping connector. Install the skill for Codex, Claude Code, or both. Each agent gets its own access identity.
tip: You only need to install the skill for the agent you use.
note: Other services use their own reviewed connector configuration.

title: Start the local service
subtitle: Keep this terminal open while you use Account Access.
narration: Start the service and leave this terminal open. Account Access runs locally while your agent works. Now open a second terminal for account setup.
tip:
Terminal 1:
Service running

Terminal 2:
Account setup
note: Keep your computer awake while tasks are running.

title: Open your account settings
subtitle: Use a second terminal.
output: Owner console opened in your browser.
narration: Run account access setup in the second terminal. Your browser opens the account settings, where you connect the account and choose what the agent can do.
tip: The setup page opens in your browser.
note: Keep this setup command open while editing account settings.

title: Enter your login once
subtitle: Open the password form, enter your username and password, and save.
tip:
Save locally

Your login is stored for permitted account access.
narration: Open the password form for your account. Enter your email or username and password, then click Save locally. Account Access can now sign in when you ask for an allowed operation.
note: Passwords are entered in the local setup page.

title: Choose what your agent can read
subtitle: Select your agent and click Allow selected operations.
tip:
Shopping account

Allow product names, descriptions and prices.
narration: Select Codex or Claude and allow the catalog read. If you use both agents, grant that read to each one. This is a standing permission, so you don't repeat the approval for every request.
note: You can change these permissions or revoke access from the same page.

title: Find the two cheapest products
subtitle: Open a fresh Codex chat and send this request.
prompt: Use $account-access to check my shopping account. Find the two cheapest products and show their names and prices. Save progress as a task.
narration: In a fresh Codex chat, ask for the two cheapest products. The agent reads the permitted catalog and compares the prices. It returns the onesie at seven dollars ninety nine, and the bike light at nine dollars ninety nine.
note: The dollar sign selects the Account Access skill.

title: Ask a follow-up through Claude Code
subtitle: Use the same connected account through another agent.
prompt: /account-access Check my shopping account and tell me the backpack price. Save progress as a task.
narration: You can use the same account from Claude Code. Ask for the backpack price. It returns twenty nine dollars ninety nine. The saved account session is reused, so you do not enter the password again.
note: Start a fresh Claude Code session after installing the skill.

title: Keep using your normal agent
subtitle: Connect once. Allow the operation. Ask for the work you need.
narration: That's the workflow: install Account Access, connect your account, grant access, and ask your agent to do the work. Keep the service running. If a website needs your approval later, complete that step in account setup and continue the task.
